lessons: Keep the BugEvidence gate, its Check-set wiring in stages.py, the tickets.py carries repo-relative lint, and the existing head-pass, base-fail and head-fail tests. Stay inside the fence and do not edit merge.py.

Fail closed on files the branch added. List the paths added between base and branch, not a filename guess. Every added path the regression needs must be covered by `carries`; otherwise the gate fails. Remove the `_is_test_path` heuristic as the only filter.

Simplest sound rule: every branch-added path outside the production fence edits must be carried. Add a test where the branch adds an uncarried non-test* input, such as a root conftest.py or data/case.json, and assert the gate fails.

Criterion 3 is still unproven. Add a `setup_replay` option that leaves the regression test file out of the base tree. Assert the gate fails when it is not carried, and passes only when it is carried and the base still fails.
run.md `## Outcome` must be one closed value such as `ok`. Rerun all three verification commands before handing off.
reason: Review found two fixable gaps: an untested absent-at-base criterion and a heuristic uncarried-file check that does not fail closed. The findings give a concrete paved road.
